# temper

> temper is a London open-fire steakhouse group: temper Soho (25 Broadwick Street, W1F 0DF, since 2016), temper City (2 Angel Court, EC2R 7HJ, near Bank) and temper Bar-B-Q & Crabshack (Covent Garden, 12 Maiden Lane, now taking bookings at https://www.opentable.com/r/temper-bbq-and-crabshack-covent-garden-london; King's Road opening later). Rare-breed British beef from one farm in North Yorkshire, whole animals butchered and dry-aged in-house (60 days average), cooked over wood and charcoal. Named one of the world's 101 best steakhouses. Tagline: Meat. Fire. Tacos.

## Key facts
- Sunday Roast (Soho only, Sundays from noon): from £29.90; Three Beast Feast £38.50pp for two; bottomless roast £55. Named best Sunday roast in London by Time Out. Usually sells out by Friday.
- Bottomless Brunch (Soho Saturdays 12–3.30pm, City Saturdays 12–4pm): Standard £45, Ultimate £60; a fire-cooked main, two tacos, 90 minutes of drinks. OpenTable Top 100 Brunch 2026.
- Lobster & Steak Bottomless Brunch (City, Saturdays 12–4pm): from £70 (£80 with half lobster).
- Taco Tuesday (both restaurants, Tuesdays from 5pm): £9.50 tacos and £9.50 margaritas.
- Butchery & Barbecue Masterclass (City, first Wednesday monthly): £150 including drinks and a three-course feast.
- Private hire: Soho private dining room 20; Soho full venue ~190; City mezzanine 50 seated / 70 standing with own bar; City full venue 240. Feast menus from £65 (City) / £75 (Soho), Fancy Feast £95.
- Bookings: OpenTable for up to 8; 9+ via DesignMyNight or reservationsmanager@temperrestaurant.com. Soho 020 3879 3834, City 020 3004 6984.
- Hours: Soho Mon 12–21.00, Tue–Sat 12–22.15, Sun 12–18.15. City Mon–Fri 12–22.15, Sat 12–16.00, closed Sun.
